Craftsmanship

One hide. One hand.
One bag.

Every Dast-e-Karigar bag starts as a single full-grain hide, chosen by hand at the tannery so the grain and colour stay consistent across the finished piece. Our karigars cut, skive and stitch each panel — no assembly line, no shortcuts.

The saddle stitching you see isn't decorative — it's what keeps the bag holding its shape for years, not seasons.

14Hrs per bag
100%Full-grain leather
